description: Calendar MONTH offset 1: March has no February predecessor. A row-offset LAG would incorrectly use January.
sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT substr(order_date, 1, 7) || '-01' AS month, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM sales GROUP BY month) SELECT c.month, c.revenue - p.revenue AS difference FROM monthly c LEFT JOIN monthly p ON p.month = date(c.month, '-1 month') ORDER BY c.month

description: Proposed null-propagating guarded division, never infinity; confirm against QuickSight before enabling division.
sql: SELECT order_id, profit * 100.0 / NULLIF(revenue, 0) AS margin FROM sales ORDER BY order_id

description: Averaging row margins differs from dividing summed profit by summed revenue.
sql: SELECT AVG(profit * 100.0 / NULLIF(revenue, 0)) AS average_row_margin, SUM(profit) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) AS aggregate_margin FROM sales

description: An all-null measure remains null, not zero.
sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE order_id = 6
